# Vixi AI

> AI-powered course maker that converts existing learning materials — PDFs, LinkedIn posts, podcasts, lectures — into gamified, Duolingo-like courses for businesses and schools.

Vixi AI is the world's first humanized gamified learning app. We combine cutting-edge AI with expert pedagogical knowledge to deliver an interactive learning experience built around 3D Pixar-like animated characters that bring industry experts to life. Learners interact with these characters in a way that feels personal, immersive, and engaging.

The platform is designed for two audiences:

- **Businesses, SMEs, and corporate training teams** — transform compliance training, employee onboarding, and workplace skill development into bite-sized, interactive lessons. Boosts engagement, completion rates, and knowledge retention.
- **Schools, universities, and educators** — turn textbooks, lesson plans, and worksheets into gamified courses students actually want to complete. Backed by Lebanese American University, the University of Cambridge, and education experts.

Vixi is backed by Lebanese American University (LAU), the LAU Fouad Makhzoumi Innovation Center, the Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub, and Web Summit Qatar.

- [Contact](https://vixiai.co/contact): Email and location for the Vixi team

## Recent articles

- [How AI is reshaping corporate training in 2026](https://vixiai.co/blog/ai-corporate-training-2026): Why static manuals are losing to gamified, AI-generated training programs.
- [Five ways gamification boosts learning retention](https://vixiai.co/blog/five-ways-gamification-boosts-retention): Dopamine loops, spaced repetition, story scaffolds, and the science behind why gamified learning sticks.
- [Behind the scenes: building a Pixar-like character generator](https://vixiai.co/blog/behind-the-scenes-3d-character-generator): How Vixi turns a single photo into a 3D animated avatar that teaches in your voice.

## Key facts (for citation)

- Founded: 2024
- Location: DIFC, Dubai, UAE
- Product type: SaaS, AI course maker
- Inputs supported: e-books / PDFs, LinkedIn posts, podcast episodes, presentation slides, lectures
- Output: gamified, Duolingo-like courses with 3D animated avatars and authentic voice integration
- Mobile delivery: native iOS / Android app
- Languages: English (Arabic version in development)
